title: Joe Williams: boyhood friend and his new scores
summary: Jones praises Joe Williams as friend, recalls neighborhood sports at 15, and Joe's recent Tonight Show appearance with new scores.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: I would like to speak about who I think is a great singer and a great friend of mine, Joe Williams. We were kids, in our early teens, I suppose, and we used to play on softball teams and baseball teams, neighborhood competition, in our early days. And my elders knew his elders. We had no idea that we would be in this business this long and have this much luck together.
Yes. Oh, I guess it goes back to when I was about 15 years old, and I'm 100 now.
No, you had a birthday last week, and it was not your hundredth.
No, it's still in two figures.

In fact I spoke with Joe yesterday. He was here doing the Johnny Carson show, and he called me up to tell me that he's -- we're doing some more of the new scores that I hadn't heard, that I just mailed to him, you know. And as I said once before, it sounds like somebody else wrote them.
Yeah, you told me earlier, off the tape, that you weren't sure that this was your material.
Yeah. But I said gee whiz, my mind has
gone in a complete different direction.
